source: Even within the memory system, one optimized level can reveal another bottleneck. Reducing ZXNAME0000XZ traffic may move the limit to L2 bandwidth. Improving L2 reuse may expose instruction issue or Tensor Core utilization. Nsight’s memory analysis explicitly treats several distinct limits: busy memory units, bandwidth between units, and the throughput of memory instruction pipelines.[3]
zh: 即使在内存系统内，一个优化级别也可能揭示另一个瓶颈。减少 ZXNAME0000XZ 流量可能会将限制转移到 L2 带宽。提高 L2 重用可能会暴露指令问题或 Tensor Core 利用率。 Nsight 的内存分析明确处理了几个不同的限制：繁忙的内存单元、单元之间的带宽以及内存指令管道的吞吐量。 [3]
